_about: Snorri Sturluson (1179-1241) in English: Heimskringla in Samuel Laing's translation (1844) as revised by R. B. Anderson (1889): the Gutenberg file names no translator, so it was identified by collating its preface against IA's scan of that edition (heimskringlaorsa01snor), which it matches word for word, and its notes are signed '--L.' (Laing) and '--Ed.' (Anderson), and the Prose (Younger) Edda in Rasmus B. Anderson's translation (1880). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain.
